relations.text: Amazon Web Servicesと戦略的協業契約を発表し、顧客のクラウド移行を共同で進める
relations.text_en: Announced a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Amazon Web Services to jointly streamline JFrog customer cloud migrations

source.label: JFrog 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Amazon Web Services to jointly streamline JFrog customer cloud migrations.

relations.text: 年次報告は、AWSはパートナーでもあるが、JFrogの機能の一部で競合し得ると述べている
relations.text_en: The annual report says AWS, while also a partner, may compete with a subset of JFrog functionality

source.label: JFrog 10-K
source.quote: While also partners, cloud providers, such as Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), Microsoft Azure (including Azure DevOps) and Alphabet Inc.’s Google Cloud, may compete with a subset of JFrog functionality.
source.note: 提携先であり、一部機能では競合し得るとの記載です。
source.note_en: Described as both a partner and a possible competitor on a subset of functionality.

relations.text: NVIDIAと協業し、透明性と追跡性を備えた安全な機械学習モデルと大規模言語モデルを提供する
relations.text_en: Announced collaboration with NVIDIA to deliver secure machine learning models and large language models with transparency, traceability, and trust

source.label: JFrog 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced collaboration with NVIDIA to deliver secure machine learning (ML) models and large language models (LLMs) with transparency, traceability, and trust.

relations.text: GitLabの年次報告が、ジェイフロッグを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names JFrog as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: GitLab 10-K
source.quote: We also compete with DevOps product collections and point solutions from vendors such as Atlassian, JFrog, and Harness.

relations.text: 年次報告は、セキュリティ分野の競合としてSynopsysなどを挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names Synopsys among security-focused companies that may compete with a subset of JFrog's security offerings

source.label: JFrog 10-K
source.quote: Some security-focused companies may compete with a subset of JFrog’s holistic security offerings or address only developer-level security, such as Aqua Security, Snyk, Checkmarx, Sonatype, and Synopsys.
